roadmap.notes: Free roam after the story. No mission replay. 15 manual save slots. Cheats disable trophies.
roadmap.completion100: 100 optional tasks, 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vaults, 15/18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 33 underwater discoveries, 100/125 Cocaine Flamingos, 42/42 Shooting Range gold, 42/42 drone time trials, 300/397 stunts, 70/80 challenges, 15/15 Bret target decks, 200/277 vehicles, 100/255 animals

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work the roadmap in order: story first (with the one missable meditation in Chapter 1), then strangers and side content, then robberies and the long 100% counts. It is the last trophy you will earn.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play through the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end. It doubles as the game's tutorial for driving and fishing, so just follow the on-screen prompts and the mission markers — no special requirement, and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. Before the chapter ends, do the balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude (see its guide) — that is the only missable step in the whole trophy list, and there is no mission replay to go back with.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. Story trophies unlock as the plot advances, so keep playing the gold mission markers in order; side content can wait until free roam.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. As with the other chapter trophies, it unlocks from story progress alone — no collectible, challenge or side mission is needed for it.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. By this point the story is near its end; keep a manual save in a spare slot before the final stretch, since the game has no mission replay.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. This is the Gold story trophy and the natural end of Stage 1 of the roadmap. After the credits, free roam opens and everything else — collectibles, robberies, the 100% grind — can be finished at your own pace.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It is a named story beat, so it unlocks by playing the main missions in order; check the mission list in the pause menu if you want to see which story missions remain.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. A heist mission, so expect a setup-and-payoff structure: follow the mission objectives, and remember cheats disable trophies, so keep them off for the whole playthrough.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Like the other named-mission trophies, it comes from story progress only and cannot be missed while the story is still playable.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Play the main missions in order and it unlocks at the end of that mission — no extra objective is hidden inside it.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. Finish the mission's objectives and the trophy pops on completion.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Another named story mission: follow the gold markers, finish the operation, and the trophy is yours.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion as tracked in the pause-menu checklist: 100 optional tasks, 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vaults, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 of 125 Cocaine Flamingos, 42/42 Shooting Range gold medals, 42/42 drone time trials, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 15/15 Bret target decks, 200 of 277 vehicles and 100 of 255 animals. This is the long grind of Stage 3 and the last Gold before the Platinum — chip away at the counters in free roam after the story, using the checklist to see what is left.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts — jumps, airtime, near-misses and similar driving feats, which the game counts as you pull them off in free roam. Find a good stunt jump and repeat it, or just drive aggressively between objectives; 300 of 397 stunts are needed for 100% anyway, so this Silver comes naturally on the way there.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — fishing, racing, the shooting range, arcade games, bowling, drone races and the rest. You only need one attempt at each, not a win, so sample everything early: it is a quick Bronze and a good tour of what Leonida offers.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each challenge has its own weapon and target pattern — learn the recoil and the timing, retry a challenge until the gold score lands, and work through the list one weapon at a time. All 42 golds also count toward 100%.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. Learn each course's racing line, cut corners where the gates allow, and retry a location until the win lands — you need a win everywhere, not just once.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different race events across Leonida. Each distinct race counts once, so spread out: try new race markers instead of replaying one you already won, and use the fastest vehicle class that fits each race.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Take the challenge when it appears, practise casting and reeling first so the timing feels natural, then out-fish him in the head-to-head — it is a contest of catches, not of gear alone.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one full arcade game run at an arcade machine. Pick a game you enjoy, learn its controls in a practice round if it offers one, and play it through to the end — a single completion is all it takes.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger mission strand, ending with his final mission. Stranger missions appear as icons on the map as you explore — take each of Andy's jobs in turn until the strand closes with this trophy.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger mission strand, ending with his final mission. Work through his jobs in order as they appear; the trophy pops when the last one is done.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger mission strand, ending with his final mission. Billy's jobs revolve around riding, so keep a good bike handy and follow each mission marker until the strand ends.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and the other stranger contacts each count as one strand when their final mission is done. Explore the map for stranger icons and clear strands one by one; this Silver lands once the eighth strand closes.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger mission strand, ending with his final mission. Take his jobs as they appear on the map and see the strand through to its last job.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger mission strand, ending with his final mission. Clear his jobs in order until the strand's final mission is complete.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. MISSABLE — read this first: one spot is on the balcony of Jason's house in Chapter 1, after the mission 'Down to Earth', when Lucia invites a morning meditation. Do that meditation before Chapter 1 ends; there is no mission replay, so missing it locks the trophy for this playthrough. The other 17 spots are found by exploring in free roam after the story — visit each one and meditate there until all 18 are done.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret as part of his stranger strand. Follow Bret's hunt missions and the tracking clues they give, take the animal down cleanly, and the trophy pops — his full target list (15 decks) also feeds the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets by finding cards scattered across Leonida. Cards are tucked into shops, interiors and hidden corners — pick up every card you spot while exploring, and three finished sets earn this Silver. For 100% you will need 15 of 18 sets, so keep collecting past this trophy.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations — the in-game scanning feature that logs places and things you point it at. Scan as you travel: every new location you WAiNK counts, and 100 scans are also required for 100% completion, so make scanning a habit on every trip.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges (of 80 in the game). Challenges are small feats scattered through activities and free roam — check the challenge list, pick the easiest ones first, and let the count build as you play. 70 of 80 are needed for 100%.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, build up a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Cause chaos together until four stars show, then break line of sight, switch vehicles, and hide until the stars clear — escaping with your partner still with you is what counts.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level between them. Plan a route with three close shops, hit each one quickly, and keep the heat on — if the wanted level drops to zero before the third robbery, the chain resets and you start again.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by driving or entering new models — each new model you get into counts once. Try everything you see: traffic, parked cars, boats and bikes all add to the count, and 200 of 277 vehicles are needed for 100%.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single activation of Combat Focus (the slow-mo aiming mode). Set it up in a busy firefight: gather enemies in view first, trigger Combat Focus, and chain five takedowns before it ends — a packed shootout is the easiest place to do it.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport — leave VCIA in a way no timetable planned, by taking an aircraft or vehicle out of the airport on your own terms. Head to the airport in free roam, grab a plane, and get airborne away from the runways.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with Rhino tanks — the heavy military response that rolls in at high wanted levels. Survive the encounter and take the fight to the tanks (or outrun them) until the trophy registers; high wanted-level chaos in open ground is where Rhinos show up.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Scout the store first, move quietly, avoid guards and cameras, grab the goods and slip out before any alarm — if you are spotted, leave and try again.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank jobs are part of the robbery side content — crack the vault, take the cash, then lose the wanted level to bank the escape. All 8 vaults count toward 100%, so keep going after this Silver pops.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Intercept one on the road in free roam, stop it, crack it open, take the cash and then lose the wanted level — the escape is part of the trophy, so do not stop running until the stars are gone.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive, fly or sail through every named region on the map until each one registers as visited — the map greys in as you go, so sweep the corners and islands you have not touched yet.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — one per gang. Gang operations are marked as you find them; hit a different gang's operation each time until all nine are covered. There are 39 operations in total for 100%, so this is just the start.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Method still unconfirmed — do not trust an invented step. The official description points to enjoying a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, but neither cited source has published a confirmed method yet. Check the KeenGamer and GTA BOOM guides linked below for the first confirmed steps as they are verified.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Method still unconfirmed — do not trust an invented step. The official description suggests smashing your way out of a vehicle showroom, but neither cited source has published a confirmed method yet. Check the KeenGamer and GTA BOOM guides linked below for the first confirmed steps as they are verified.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play through a game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — follow through on a full game, frame by frame, rather than quitting halfway. Bowling is one of the 9 activity types, so it also counts toward trying everything for Master of None.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Earn it through a standout moment with your partner — the description points to a partnership with mass appeal, a shared moment that draws attention. The exact trigger is still being pinned down by the cited guides; play the partner content in free roam and check the KeenGamer and GTA BOOM links below for the confirmed trigger.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices across the game — the description tracks decisions made, for better or worse, and PlayStation counts them toward 500. Keep playing: story choices, side decisions and free-roam choices all feed the counter, and the trophy pops once the count is reached.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Method still unconfirmed — do not trust an invented step. The official description ('Second time's the charm') hints at succeeding on a second attempt at something, but neither cited source has published a confirmed method yet. Check the KeenGamer and GTA BOOM guides linked below for the first confirmed steps as they are verified.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Method still unconfirmed — do not trust an invented step. The official description ('What the hell just happened?') hints at witnessing something strange in the world, but neither cited source has published a confirmed method yet. Check the KeenGamer and GTA BOOM guides linked below for the first confirmed steps as they are verified.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Method still unconfirmed — do not trust an invented step. The official description points to knocking someone over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle (a melee drive-by), but neither cited source has published a confirmed method yet. Check the KeenGamer and GTA BOOM guides linked below for the first confirmed steps as they are verified.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; take them to a laundering contact, convert them in batches, and let the total build toward $250,000 — it is a slow earner, so launder regularly instead of saving it all for the end.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — weapons, clothes, vehicles, food and other stores all count toward the total. Buy the gear you actually want as you play and the counter climbs on its own; late in the game, top it up with a vehicle or weapon purchase.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Garages are bought through the property system — save up, buy each one as you find it, and the trophy pops when the eighth garage is yours. Garages also give you somewhere to store the vehicles you discover.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app on the in-game phone, add vehicles you own or find, and repeat until ten are registered — it pairs naturally with discovering vehicles for Whip It Good.
